description:
HushThreads v0.0.14 has 19 patches for Threads 451.0.0.51.80 (com.instagram.barcelona).

This release moves to Threads 451 and patches that version only. All 11 HushThreads settings pages are redesigned, with separate cards and Search and Pause at the top of the home page. A long press on the Threads logo at the top of your feed opens HushThreads settings, even while HushThreads is paused. Flip a switch that needs a restart and a Restart row shows at the top of settings. Tap it and Threads reopens on the page you were on.

Sign in with your Instagram username and password.

Validation: 859 runtime tests passed locally. All 258 patch tests passed too, along with both Android lints. All 19 patches applied to Threads 451.0.0.51.80 without forcing, and the release receipt records the run.

Needs Morphe Manager 1.34.0 or newer. Patch the arm64-v8a bundle of Threads 451.0.0.51.80 (version code 512108444). The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a Threads APK. Uninstall the stock Threads first, and keep the manager's signing key for updates.
